rows.title: PLANNER_SEARCH: what each part of the search's command does in the real simulated body (32 decisions of checkpoint 481,800; decision files of 479,350)
rows.question: From 32 saved planning decisions of checkpoint 481,800: when production's search changes only one group of numbers (position, orientation, radius, strength, hand joints), or runs at a learning rate of 0.01 or 0.001, or with updates proportional to the gradient, does the selected command end nearer its goal in the real simulated body than the motor controller's own command from the same saved world state, per sense, and how far apart do two commands of production's search end when their inputs differ by 0.00001?
rows.why: Production's record of run seg41o_1431 reads a predicted gain of the planned command (goal distance 0.797 against the motor controller's 0.841) that the before reading on 479,350 did not find in the real body (16 of 32 decisions nearer). The repair PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR has to state which numbers its search may change and by how much. That choice needs the real effect of each group: a group whose change does nothing in the real body, or whose numbers the decoder never reads (radius; the positions of rows the decoder solves no position for), is left at the motor controller's values by the repair; the real effect at the two smaller learning rates says whether steps of a few cm and degrees carry the gain or lose it.
rows.gof_link: A planned command helps gain of function only when it ends nearer its goal in the real body, in the senses a command can change (proprioception first, then vision); this row reads that per part of today's command.

rows.title: PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR design reading: the trust region's shape, size and smoothing rows by the body's real outcome (64 decisions of checkpoint 481,800)
rows.question: From 64 saved planning decisions of checkpoint 481,800 (8 bodies x 8): when the search takes one step from the motor controller's command in trust units (5 cm of target position, 28.6 degrees of target turn, 3.23 degrees of the eyes, 0.05 of strength per number) along minus the objective's gradient averaged over 8 commands drawn around the motor controller's, how does the real goal distance in proprioception plus vision after the 5-model-step hold answer to the step's length (1, 2, 4 and 8 trust units), to the region's shape (one region over every number, or the strengths in a region of their own), to the number of smoothing rows (0, 8, 16), and which of these does the launch flag's search take?
rows.why: PLANNER_SEARCH is CAUSE KNOWN to part ways with itself where the motor encoder's attention changes the body handle it reads; production's Adam crosses such changes at most of its updates. The repair PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR (--planner-search trust_v1, lem/model/planner_search.py) takes one step inside a trust region. Its constants must come from measurement, not from a choice by hand: the region's size (requirement R4), its shape, and how many commands the gradient is averaged over. A development decision (body 0, first decision of 481,800) read that the gradient at the motor controller's command is 4.4 times as long as its mean over 8 commands around it and has a cosine of 0.63 with that mean, and that in one region 0.69 of the squared step went to the strengths (the effort term's gradient is as long in trust units as the goal distance's mean gradient). This row reads what each choice does in the real body, on the senses a command can change, so the flag's settings are fixed by a rule written here before the reading.
rows.gof_link: The planner helps gain of function only when its command ends nearer the goal in the real body in proprioception and vision; this reading sets the search's constants on that outcome and on nothing predicted.
inputs: Production checkpoint ckpt_step_481800 of run H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg41o_1431 (read only) and its saved eight-world episode; per body its first 8 saved planning decisions, 10 model steps or more apart, reached under the model's own behaviour.

Reference arms: reflex (the motor controller's command), start_hand (the motor controller's command followed by the hand stage that follows every search: the reference every search arm is read against), chosen (production's Adam search as it ran in the session).

Step arms, each the whole step with no selection (so the step's own outcome is read): b_r1, b_r2, b_r4, b_r8 (one region, 8 smoothing rows, length 1, 2, 4, 8 trust units); s_r1, s_r2, s_r4, s_r8 (the strengths in a region of their own, the same lengths in each region); s16_r4 and s0_r4 (split regions, 16 and 0 smoothing rows, length 4). No number moves farther than 2 trust units (the babble's own range in 95 of 100 draws).

Arms for the record only: best16 (the command of lowest predicted objective among the motor controller's and 16 commands drawn around it at the babble's sizes: candidates ranked by predicted consequence, no gradient step) and s_r4_w (s_r4 with each sense's goal distance weighted by --goal-sense-weights own_command's weights formed from the run's last 20 reports).

steps: Two worker processes of 4 threads each (bodies 0 to 3 and 4 to 7), run from an export of the pinned commit (docs/gain_of_function_v4/pinned_job.py). Per body, restore its saved world and model state with learning off, run under the model's own behaviour to a planning decision, take a snapshot, write the decision file.
Per decision and arm, run LemLite._plan_chain from the decision's captured state with the arm's search (hand stage as production runs it); the snapshot is restored before every search.

Route checks that stop the job: the probe's predicted goal distance of chosen and reflex must equal the planning record's to 0.001; the physical traces of two executions of reflex and of chosen must be bit-identical; the weights are hashed before and after.

Execute every arm's command from the identical restored snapshot for the 5-model-step hold. After the first and the fifth model step read each sense's raw encoder token and its top-down-gated token; goal distance per sense = the mean over the token's 192 numbers of (token - the goal's token) squared.

Summarise per arm, arm minus start_hand: predicted 1 model step ahead, real after 1 model step and real after the hold, for proprioception plus vision, each sense and the plain sum, on the raw tokens and on the gated tokens, as the mean over the 8 body means with a 95% interval from resampling whole bodies.

Compose the flag's form of the search from the executed arms: for a shape (b or s) and a largest length R (4 or 8), per decision the command of lowest PREDICTED objective among start_hand and the step arms of lengths R/4, R/2 and R; its real outcome is that command's.
A development run on body 0 with 1 decision checked the route and the cost before this row was written; its one decision is among the 64 and no rule below was fitted to it.
measures: P: real goal distance in proprioception plus vision after the hold on the raw encoder tokens, arm minus start_hand from the same saved state, squared token units: below 0 = the arm's command ended nearer the goal; start_hand's own level is the scale.
P1: the same after 1 model step (the horizon the search predicts); the plain sum and tactile beside both, as the check that nothing got worse.
Per step arm: the share of the squared step that went to the strengths, the step per group in physical units, the predicted goal distance at the start and at the step.
Per arm the command's difference from the motor controller's as the body receives it (degrees on the average body handle, cm, strength) and the handles' real displacement over the hold.
rows.target_metric: P of the composed search: below 0 = the search's command ended nearer its goal than the motor controller's command with the same hand stage, in the senses a command can change; 0 = no nearer.
rows.baseline: start_hand (0 by construction) and chosen (production's Adam search from the same saved state).
rows.statistical_line: A reading is told from noise when its 95% interval from resampling the 8 bodies lies entirely on one side of 0; two arms are told apart when the mean of their per-decision difference is larger than its standard error over the 64 decisions.
rows.pass_line: No pass or fail line on the outcome: a design reading whose rule fixes the flag's settings. RULE, applied in this sequence to P. (1) Shape: the composed search of shape s replaces shape b when its P is lower at R = 4 and at R = 8 by more than the standard error of the paired difference; when the outcome does not tell the two apart, the shape is s if the strengths take more than half of the squared step in the one-region arms (mean over decisions of b_r4), else b. (2) Largest length: R = 8 when the chosen shape's composed search has a lower P at 8 than at 4 by more than the standard error of the paired difference, else R = 4. (3) Smoothing rows: 16 when s16_r4's P is below s_r4's by more than the standard error of the paired difference; 0 when s0_r4's is; else 8. (4) best16 and s_r4_w select nothing. The job is complete when all 64 decisions are measured with every route check held.
rows.pass_line_basis: The rule prefers the smaller region and the fewer rows whenever the body's outcome cannot tell two settings apart, because a smaller step stays nearer the commands the forward model was trained on and fewer rows cost fewer passes. The strengths' half: with more than half of the squared step on the strengths the region is mostly spent on numbers the goal distance does not ask to change, which is the finding the repair exists to remove (the predicted gain consisting of a strength cut). Reachability: the paired difference between two step arms from one saved state has no between-state noise; on the development decision the real outcome of a step of length 4 differed from start_hand's by 0.008 in P while Adam's command differed by 0.142, so differences of a few thousandths are what the 64 decisions can resolve. Every constant fixed here is read once more on checkpoint 480,829 (row planner_search_evidence_physical_480829), which plays no part in the rule.

rows.title: PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR design reading without a world: the gradient over smoothing rows, the predicted objective along the step, and the step's float32 noise (decisions of checkpoint 481,800)
rows.question: On the saved planning decisions of checkpoint 481,800: how long is the objective's gradient in trust units at the motor controller's command and averaged over 8, 16 and 32 commands around it, do two independent sets of rows give the same mean direction, how does the predicted objective change along the step at lengths from 0.125 to 8 trust units, and by how much does the mean direction change when the present tokens change by 0.00001 and by 0.0001?
rows.why: Three constants and one line of the repair PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR rest on these readings. The gradient floor (the gradient length at which the step is half its largest length) must sit above the gradient's own float32 noise and far below its ordinary length, so both are measured. The stability line of requirement R2 has to be declared from a float32 noise measurement before the repaired search's stability is read. And the reason for averaging the gradient over rows (the gradient at one command belongs to the piece of the predictor between two changes of the motor encoder's attention) is stated in the record with these numbers.
rows.gof_link: A search whose step shrinks smoothly where the predictor does not answer and whose command repeats for the same state is the condition for any planned command to be a function of the state and the goal.
inputs: The decision files of row planner_search_mechanism_arms (32 decisions of checkpoint 481,800) and the checkpoint's weights, read only.

The trust_v1 search's own objects through its probe hook (lem/model/planner_search.py, settings inspect): the searched numbers (a step in trust units from the motor controller's command) and the objective (intention_generator.SearchObjective with the decision's execution transform, smoother and hand assembly).
Smoothing rows: two independent sets of 32 fixed draws (16 standard normal draws and their negatives, seeds 20261005 and 20261006) at scales 0.35, 1 and 2 trust units.
The script docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/design_offline.py (version planner_search_design_offline_v1) at the pinned commit.
steps: Build the checkpoint's model with learning off (weights hashed before and after) and configure the hand geometry from the decision files; stop when the model differs from the digest the files carry.

Per decision: the objective's gradient at the motor controller's command and at every smoothing row (one batched forward and backward pass of 33 rows per set and scale); the mean over the first 8, 16 and 32 rows of each set; the cosine between the two sets' means; the cosine with the gradient at the motor controller's command; each group's share of the squared gradient; the goal term's and the effort term's gradients apart.

Per decision: the predicted objective along four unit directions (minus the gradient at the motor controller's command, minus the 8-row and the 32-row mean gradient, minus the 8-row mean gradient of the goal term alone) at lengths 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4 and 8 trust units, with and without the limit of 2 trust units per number: total, goal distance, effort term, every sense's goal distance.
Per decision: the 8-row mean gradient again from present tokens with Gaussian noise of standard deviation 0.00001 and 0.0001 (2 draws each): the change of its unit direction and of its length.
A development run on one decision (body 0, first decision) was made while the script was written.
measures: Gradient length in trust units (objective units per trust unit of step) at the motor controller's command and for each row count; cosine between two independent row sets (1 = the same direction whichever rows are drawn, 0 = unrelated).
Predicted objective minus the start's along each direction and length; the count of decisions whose predicted goal distance is below the start's.

Under the token noise: the length of the difference between the mean gradient's unit direction with and without the noise (0 = unchanged, 1.41 = unrelated), the relative and the absolute change of the mean gradient's length, and the absolute change of its largest component.
rows.target_metric: The change of the step's unit direction for a 0.00001 change of the present tokens: 0 = unchanged; the development decision read 0.00003.
rows.baseline: Production's Adam on the same decisions (row planner_search_mechanism_offline): its selected command changes by tens of degrees for the same token change.
rows.statistical_line: Means over the 32 decisions with quartiles; the noise readings are also given as the largest over all decisions and draws.
rows.pass_line: No pass or fail line: a measurement that sets one constant by the rule written here. The gradient floor of lem/model/planner_search.py is 10 times the largest absolute change, under the 0.00001 noise over all decisions and draws, of the 8-row mean gradient's length and of its largest component (the two quantities the step's factor divides by). The stability line of the repaired search is declared by row planner_search_evidence_offline from the float32 floor that row measures itself (the same decisions searched on the processor and on the graphics card), not from this reading.
rows.pass_line_basis: A floor at 10 times the gradient's change under input noise of 0.00001 makes the step shrink where the gradient cannot be told from that change and leaves it at its full size elsewhere (on the development decision the mean gradient's length was 0.0030 and its noise 0.00000004, five powers of ten apart). The search's step since commit 73153f77a is the ray along minus the mean gradient to the trust region's boundary, its factor min(radius / (length + floor), box / (largest component + floor)); both divisors are measured here. The curves with the limit of 2 trust units per number clamp each number, which the search no longer does; they are read as the predicted objective along the ray only where no number reaches the limit.

rows.question: On the saved planning decisions of checkpoints 479,350 and 481,800: of the change of production's selected command when the present tokens change by 0.00001, how much is left when the attention weights of the motor encoder are held at their values at the search's starting command, when those of the forward model's 4 blocks are held as well, and when every attention module of the predictor's route is held? And, at each decision's starting command: are the two paths beside the motor encoder's pool on H84 (the liveness repair's all-element path and the asked change) present and live, and what share of the motor token and of its gradient with respect to the command does each carry (both stay live under every hold)?
rows.why: Row planner_search_mechanism_offline was read on checkpoint 479,350 at 3:01 AM PDT and its pass line is not met there: line 1 holds (production's Adam changes the selected command by 22.3 degrees on the average handle), line 2 does not (an attention weight of the motor encoder differs by more than 0.01 at the first update where the gradients differ in 57 of 64 pairs, but the executed commands already differ by more than 0.001 at that update in 37 of them, so the two conditions hold together in 24 of 64), and line 3 does not (with the motor encoder's attention held the change is 0.75 degrees, one thirtieth of 22.3 and not under one hundredth). So the motor encoder's attention is the largest amplifier on that checkpoint and not the only one. That row's on-fail action is a further localisation before the mechanism is written as known: this row. The two sites left were named there: the forward model's own attention and the command's transform.
rows.gof_link: Whether PLANNER_SEARCH is written CAUSE KNOWN, and whether the repair removes the cause or goes around a part of it (the contract's fifth question), rests on which part of the predictor's route turns a 0.00001 difference into a different command.

The script docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/mechanism_controls.py (version planner_search_mechanism_controls_v1) at the pinned commit.

The two paths beside the pool as run seg41o_1431 has them (args.json: liveness_repair on, motor_asked_change on): lem/model/liveness.py AllElementPath (POOL_PATHS motor, rank 19, a forward hook on the pool's attention module) and lem/model/motor_asked_change.py (a forward hook on the motor encoder). The hold replaces only the attention modules' own arithmetic, so both paths add their outputs under every hold.
steps: Build each checkpoint's model with learning off (weights hashed before and after); stop when the model differs from the digest the decision files carry.

Per decision, production's Adam (learning rate 0.1, 20 updates) searches the batch four times: live (nothing held); motor (the motor encoder's 3 attention modules held); motor_core (those and the 12 attention modules of the forward model's 4 blocks); all (every torch.nn.MultiheadAttention module of the motor encoder, the forward model and the prediction heads, 20 modules).

A held module computes its output as its output projection of (the attention weights it had at the search's starting command, each row its own) times (its value projection of its current input): the module's own arithmetic with the softmax of query times key replaced by the held weights. At the first call this arithmetic is compared with the module's own output; a difference above 0.0001 of the output's largest number stops the job.

Per control: row j's selected command against row 0's in degrees on the average body handle that is not a finger, cm on the rows whose position the decoder solves for, strength and radians of hand joints; the step from the motor controller's command; the predicted goal distance at the start and at the selection.

A development run on one decision (body 0, first decision of 481,800, processor) read 36.7 degrees live, 0.023 with the motor encoder held and 0.011 with the forward model's blocks held as well, before the lines below were written.

At each decision's starting command (the motor controller's command through the decision's execution transform): the motor token and its gradient with respect to the command along 4 fixed random directions in token space; then the same with the all-element path's output layer set to 0, with the asked change's output layer set to 0, and with both (each put back to the bit, checked on the weights).
measures: Change of the selected command between two rows whose present tokens differ by 0.00001: degrees on the average body handle (0 = the same command; production's live search read 22.3 on 479,350).
The share of the live change left under each control (1 = holding changes nothing, 0 = no change left).

Per path: the change of the motor token when the path's output layer is 0, as a share of the token's length (0 = the path adds nothing, 1 = as large as the token), and the change of the token's gradient with respect to the command, as a share of the gradient's length (0 = no gradient passes the path).
rows.target_metric: The share of the live change left with every attention module of the predictor's route held: 0 = the attention's changes of the token or handle they read carry the whole amplification; 1 = none of it.
rows.baseline: The live search of the same job (the control named live).
rows.statistical_line: Means over 4 noise rows x the decisions (64 pairs on 479,350, 128 on 481,800), the two checkpoints read apart; the median pair and the count of pairs under 0.1 degrees are given beside the mean because single pairs can differ by a factor of 100.
rows.pass_line: PLANNER_SEARCH is written CAUSE KNOWN with the predictor's attention as the place of amplification when the control named all leaves under 0.01 of the live change on both checkpoints. When it leaves more, the mechanism is written with what the controls show removed and what they leave, the part left is named as not localised (Adam's update on numbers whose gradient is near its own floor of 0.00000001, the limits of the command's transform, and the two attention-like modules that are not held: the gaze copy's and the all-slot paths'), and the record answers the contract's fifth question for that part with: the repair goes around it.
rows.pass_line_basis: One hundredth is the line row planner_search_mechanism_offline declared for the motor encoder alone; it is kept for the wider control so the two rows are judged alike. Reachability: the development decision read 0.0003 of the live change with the motor encoder and the forward model held; on 479,350 the motor encoder alone left 0.034, so the wider control has to remove a further factor of 3.4 there.

rows.title: Planner corrections: unit tests, identity, planted defects
rows.question: Does branch planner/corrections-2026-10-05, with every planner switch at its default, train bit for bit as production's code on the fixture learner, do its unit tests pass, and is each of 42 planted defects caught by a named test?
rows.why: The branch adds readings that ship without a flag (goal progress in fixed units: in the plan record, in the causal chain record and in the stats block) and changes three switches that must be off by default. The coordinator merges nothing of it into production's code unless every flag-absent run equals production's at every model step and a state production's code saved resumes the same (the contract's section 5). The job also covers the switch-off identity of PLANNER_GOAL_DISTANCE (--goal-sense-weights) and PLANNER_GOAL_SELECTION (--goal-locality).
rows.gof_link: Trustworthy measurement and control: a planner reading that changed a command or a trained number would corrupt the training it measures, and a switch that is not exactly off when off would enter the restart configuration unqualified.
inputs: This branch's Source/Python, and production's commit 18771f8a4 exported with git archive into a temporary folder.

The fixture learner of Source/Python/mimo_bridge/tests/swap_test_fixture.py: built by the trainer's own builder from H84's learner flags at width 32, 3 bodies, on the processor, driven on seeded synthetic frames with the trainer's latch rule.

The six unit test files of this work (test_goal_sense_weights.py, test_goal_progress_record.py, test_goal_locality_weighted.py, test_planner_segment_watch.py, test_planner_recovery_tools.py, test_probe_planner_weaknesses.py) and 13 existing test files or tests of the code the branch edits.
42 planted defects, each one exact text replacement in one file (planted_defects.py lists them with the test that must catch each).
The weights' basis: the stats records of run segments seg41m (model steps 474,900 to 479,350) and seg41o (479,400 to 481,800), read only, and a seeded simulation of 20,000 windows of 100 pairs.
steps: Unit tests: pytest on the six test files of this work, then on the existing ones. An existing test that fails is run again on an export of production's commit and counts against the branch only when it passes there.

Identity, lockstep: in each of production's three launch settings (a hold of 5 model steps with a plan every 10; a hold of 3 with a plan every 7; the first with controllability's stillness floors at 0) production's code and the branch each run 260 model steps of the fixture with a causal chain recorder driven as the trainer drives it. Compared at every model step: loss and gradient norm (exact), hashes of the command, the gaze, the loss breakdown, the wellness values and three random streams; every 10 model steps one hash over every parameter, buffer and optimizer state tensor. With no planner flag, with --goal-locality on under both codes and with --prospective-wellness add under both codes the two must be equal, and every line production's recorder wrote must be inside the branch's line. --goal-sense-weights own_command with an empty window must equal production's default.
Identity, sensitivity (first setting): --goal-sense-weights own_command with a filled window, --goal-locality weighted, and the three switches together must each differ from production's default.

Identity, resume: production's code runs 120 model steps and saves a checkpoint and the learner's continuation state; production's code and the branch each load it and run 140 more. They must be equal at every model step and in the state hash right after the load. The branch with each switch on must load the same state without a refusal and run every model step.
Planted defects: each defect is planted alone in a temporary copy of the branch's code and the tests named beside it must fail; the clean copy must pass before the first and after the last.

The weights' basis (goal_sense_weights_basis.py): the null simulation (own-command and control errors drawn alike) and the two run segments' readings recomputed; each of the 35 numbers lem/model/goal_sense_weights.py's docstring states from them is compared with the recomputation at the digits the docstring prints.
measures: Unit tests: counts passed and failed (pass = 0 failed among the tests that pass on production's commit).

Identity: per run the first model step at which a compared value differs (none = identical over all 260 or 140 model steps; a must-differ run reads its first differing model step) and the count of state hashes compared.
Planted defects: caught of 42 (42 = each defect is caught by its named test, 0 = no test sees any).
The weights' basis: stated numbers equal to the recomputation, of 35 (35 = every stated number traces to the files, 0 = none).
rows.target_metric: The count of model steps at which the branch with no planner flag differs from production's code: 0 = identical training, 260 = different from the first model step.
rows.baseline: Production's code against itself reads 0 differing model steps by construction. The must-differ runs show what a difference reads: a first differing model step at or after the first planning decision.
rows.statistical_line: No noise: both codes run one seeded fixture on one thread, so any difference is a code difference. Equality is exact (float values compared as hex).
rows.material_gof_line: not yet defined: this row guards the measurement and the restart configuration; it measures no ability.
rows.pass_line: Every unit test of this work passes; no existing test fails that passes on production's commit; every must-equal run has no differing value at any model step and an equal final state hash, with production's recorder lines inside the branch's; every must-differ run differs; the resumed runs are equal and no load is refused; 42 of 42 planted defects are caught and the clean copy passes before and after; 35 of 35 stated numbers of the weights' basis recomputed.
rows.pass_line_basis: The switch contract (docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/CONTRACT_2026-10-05.md section 5): with every new flag absent the code trains bit for bit as production's tip, shown by a lockstep run against production's commit and by a resume of a state production's code saved. Bit-for-bit equality has no noise, so the line is exact equality. The must-differ runs are the control that the comparison can fail. Reachability: the same fixture and method passed for the planner branch of Oct 4 (row restart_candidate_planner_cpu_checks: no difference in 260 model steps in two settings, 16 of 16 planted defects caught; file D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/candidate_planner/cpu_checks_final/cpu_checks_result.json). What the fixture cannot show: it has no world and no hand stage; row planner_corrections_saved_decisions_481800 covers the real model.

The failing part (a unit test, the first differing model step and its field, a refused load, a defect no test caught) is repaired on this branch and this row runs again before any other row reads the branch's code. rows.title: Saved planning decisions replayed, checkpoint 481,800
rows.question: On saved planning decisions of checkpoint 481,800 at H84's full size, does the branch with every planner switch at its default give production's commands and planning records at every model step, and do each decision's goal, alternatives, distances and realised goal progress reproduce from the saved decision?
rows.why: The fixture learner has no world and no hand stage. This job runs the whole loop the corrections live in: a planning decision inside the model's own step, with the hand stage and the decision record, on the checkpoint training is held at. The coordinator needs it before the readings are merged; the three segment rows take the level and the spread of the new realised reading from its result.
rows.gof_link: Trustworthy measurement of the planner: the directive's planner test (does the planned command end nearer its goal than the motor controller's command) needs a goal-progress reading in units no switch changes and a decision record that reproduces.
inputs: Checkpoint D:/UEMA_Research/Saved/mimo_bridge/experiments/H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg41o_1431/checkpoints/ckpt_step_481800 (read only) and its saved eight-world episode.
Production's commit 18771f8a4 exported with git archive (the record stage runs it) and this branch's Source/Python (the replay stage).
Per body, 45 model steps of the model's own behaviour from the saved state (5 planning decisions per body, 40 in all); for each switch arm the first 25 of those model steps.
For the weights arm: the senses' readings, standard errors and lower bounds from the last 20 stats reports of the checkpoint's run (one pair per report).
steps: Record (production's code, a process of its own): per body the probe harness restores the saved world and the model's saved state and lets the model live 45 model steps with the trainer's latch rule, learning off. Kept per model step: the frames the model step read, the executed command handed to it, and its outputs (command, gaze, hand joint goal, author, planning record, intention record, hashes of the tokens and of three random streams).

Replay, arm off (this branch's code, every planner switch at its default, a causal chain recorder attached): the model reads the recorded frames and executed commands, so both codes get identical inputs. Every recorded output must equal this branch's at every model step; every field production's records hold must be equal in this branch's records.

At every planning decision of arm off, with the model's state saved before and restored after: the ranked values recomputed from the goal ring must give the recorded goal's ring index and tokens; the four alternatives formed twice must be equal bit for bit and score to the recorded predicted wellness sums and goal distances; per-sense distances recomputed in float64 from the record's own tokens must sum to the record's plain and weighted distances and to its reported distances; the search run again from the captured decision must return the recorded command.
Realised goal progress: every goal_progress_realised line the recorder wrote is recomputed in float64 from the tokens the replay collected itself.

Arms weights, locality_on, locality_weighted, prospective (the switch set on the same model after the saved state is restored): each arm's commands must differ from production's; every goal of the two locality arms must be reproduced by the second implementation of the rule (goal_reference.py); the weights arm's weights must be reproduced from the decision's recorded bounds and its score decomposition must hold with the weights on.
measures: Identity: the count of model steps (of 8 bodies x 45) at which an output differs: 0 = identical, 360 = every model step.

Per check the largest absolute difference between the recorded and the recomputed value, in the units of the value (goal distances: the search's starting distance on production's record of seg41o reads 0.80 at the median and 0.13 to 1.73 between the 5th and the 95th percentile; wellness sums 0 to 5): 0 = equal.

Readings without a pass line: the predicted plain gap (100 x (1 - predicted plain distance of the planned command / of the motor controller's command): 0 = predicted no nearer, 100 = on the goal), and per author the realised change of the plain goal distance over the hold (below 0 = the body ended nearer the goal) with its standard deviation between body commands.
rows.target_metric: The count of model steps at which this branch's outputs differ from production's recorded outputs: 0 = identical on the real model with the hand stage, 360 = every model step differs.
rows.baseline: Production's code replayed on its own recorded frames reads 0 differences by construction; each switch arm shows what a difference reads (a first differing command at the first planning decision).
rows.statistical_line: No noise: the branch's model reads the recorded frames, so both codes get identical inputs on one device, and a difference is a code difference. The recomputations compare two computations of one quantity: float32 against float64 on sums of size 1 differ by under 0.000002.
rows.material_gof_line: not yet defined: this row qualifies the measurement, not an ability.
rows.pass_line: Identity: no output differs at any model step on any body, with no recorder failure and no planning-record failure. Goal construction, candidate determinism, score decomposition, replay: every decision holds its check, with recomputation differences at or under 0.000002. Realised goal progress: every recorded line equals its recomputation within 0.000002 and both authors were read. Switch arms: every arm differs from production's commands on every body; no locality goal is left unreproduced; the weights arm ran on measured weights, reproduced from the recorded bounds.
rows.pass_line_basis: Identity is exact equality (no noise). The recomputation line 0.000002: a float32 number of size 1 has a grid step of 0.00000012, and the recorder rounds its line's numbers to 6 decimals. Reachability, measured: the development run of Oct 5 on body 0, 12 model steps, 2 decisions held every check (file D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/planner_corrections/dev/sdc_smoke/result.json): 0 differing model steps, alternatives' goal distances within 0.00000004, score decomposition within 0.0000005, the search run again equal to the recorded command, the realised lines within 0.0000005, all four arms differing at the first decision. What it cannot show: the frames are production's, so no arm's physical outcome is measured (that is paired_gate.py); the model runs on the processor one body at a time, where production runs 8 bodies on the graphics card.

rows.title: Prospective term: the predictor's ranking of commands
rows.question: On saved planning decisions of checkpoint 481,800, does the wellness predictor rank the candidate commands of one decision as their realised wellness ranks them, and does its output differ between the commands of one decision?
rows.why: PLANNER_PROSPECTIVE_TERM (--prospective-wellness add) adds 0.15 x (1 - the predictor's mean of tactile_comfort, capability and motor_state on the predicted next tokens) to the search's objective. It can change a command only as far as those three outputs differ between candidate commands, and it helps only when they differ the way the realised values differ. This reading is the first gate line of the term: while it is not met, no training pause is spent on the term's paired gate and the term stays BUILT/OFF.
rows.gof_link: Wellness through the planner (directive section 2): prospective wellness is accepted only if it helps pick commands whose real outcomes are better, which needs a predictor that ranks commands.
inputs: Checkpoint D:/UEMA_Research/Saved/mimo_bridge/experiments/H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg41o_1431/checkpoints/ckpt_step_481800 (read only) and its saved eight-world episode.
Per body 4 saved planning decisions of the model's own behaviour, at least 20 model steps apart (32 decisions).
At each decision the five candidate commands of the production record: the planned command, hold, the motor controller's own command, two seeded babble-sized perturbations of the planned command.

Realised: each candidate executed from the identical restored world state for its hold of 5 model steps, the branch run twice and its physical trace required bit-identical; the grounded wellness terms after 1 model step and averaged over the hold.

Readings: of all pairs of one decision's candidates, how many in 100 the predicted value puts in the sequence of their realised value (95% interval from resampling whole bodies); the standard deviation of the predicted value between one decision's commands beside the realised one's; the correlation between decisions.

The second gate line is not measured by this job: every layer of the predictor receiving a gradient above 0. Its last measurement (Oct 4, checkpoint 479,350, row autocast_cache_gradient_audit_479350) read exactly 0 on the middle layer wellness.approximate.net.2; the result carries it with that source.
measures: Ranking, pairs in 100: 50 = chance, 80 to 90 = a ranking a search can use, 100 = every pair.

Spread ratio: the predicted standard deviation between one decision's commands over the realised one: 0 = every command of a decision gets the same predicted value, 1 = the predictor separates them as much as reality does.
The count of decisions (of 32) in which the predicted value is the same for all five commands to 6 decimals.
Correlation between decisions of predicted with realised, -1 to 1 (1 = the predictor follows the level from state to state).
rows.target_metric: Pairs in 100 of one decision's candidate commands that the predictor's mean of tactile_comfort, capability and motor_state ranks as their realised mean over the hold ranks them: 50 = chance, 100 = every pair.
rows.baseline: 50 of 100 (a coin). On checkpoint 479,350 (Oct 4, 32 decisions) the five-term sum read 56.0 over the hold (interval 50.8 to 62.1) and 53.3 after 1 model step (48.5 to 58.3); the predicted spread between one decision's commands was 0.20 and 0.27 of the realised spread.

rows.material_gof_line: 80 to 90 of 100 pairs: the ranking a search can use (mimo_bridge/tools/command_ranking.py RULES). The gate line (lower end above 50) only excludes chance.
rows.pass_line: G1: the ranking of the three bodily outputs over the hold has the lower end of its 95% interval above 50 of 100. G2 (not measured here): every tensor that computes the wellness predictor's output (its own layers, and the liveness repair's rows where they compute a layer's units) receives a gradient above 0 from the wellness lesson in a live model step (restated Oct 5, 2026: the liveness repair computes all 128 units of wellness.approximate.net.2, whose own weights are read by nothing and so always get 0; row investigate_wellness_predictor_gradient_481800, docs/gain_of_function_v4/coordinator/INVESTIGATION_WELLNESS_GRADIENT_MOTOR_POOL_2026-10-05.md on branch investigate/wellness-gradient-motor-pool-2026-10-05). rows.why: The three segment rows name the paired gate as their gate and as their pass reading, to be run the day the repaired search (PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR) is merged. A gate tool that has never run end to end would cost that day a training pause. This job reads NO switch: 2 decisions with 2 draws decide nothing, and the adam search's selected command turns by 23.2 degrees per body handle under a token change of 0.00001. The job also covers the switches of PLANNER_GOAL_SELECTION (--goal-locality on and weighted) and PLANNER_PROSPECTIVE_WELLNESS.

Per decision: the search without the switch and with each of the four switch settings (weights, locality_on, locality_weighted, prospective), 2 draws each (draw 0 on the captured tokens, draw 1 with Gaussian noise of standard deviation 0.00001 on the real senses' present tokens).
For the weights arm: the senses' bounds from the last 20 stats reports of the checkpoint's run.

rows.title: PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR design reading: the trust region's limits, shape and smoothing rows by the body's real outcome, beside the two best searches of the mechanism reading (64 decisions of checkpoint 481,800)
rows.question: From 64 saved planning decisions of checkpoint 481,800 (8 bodies x 8): when the search steps from the motor controller's command along minus the objective's gradient averaged over 8 commands drawn around it, as far as the trust region allows (no number past B trust units, B = 0.5, 1, 2 or 4; or a length of at most 8 trust units with no number past 2; a trust unit is 5 cm of target position, 28.6 degrees of target turn, 3.23 degrees of the eyes, 0.05 of strength, 0.192 rad of a hand joint), how does the real goal distance in proprioception plus vision after the 5-model-step hold answer to those limits, to the region's shape (one region, or the strengths in a region of their own) and to the number of smoothing rows (0, 8, 16); which of these does the launch flag's search take; and how does it compare on the same decisions with gradient descent in the command's own units and with Adam at learning rate 0.01?
rows.why: Row planner_search_mechanism_arms (32 decisions of 481,800, finished 3:28 AM PDT, tokens as fed) read the largest real gains after the hold, against the motor controller's command, for gradient descent in the command's own units (plain sum -0.083, interval -0.118 to -0.050, 8 of 8 bodies below 0; its position step from the motor controller's command was 31 cm on 479,350) and for Adam at learning rate 0.01 (proprioception plus vision -0.065, interval -0.125 to -0.008), against -0.030 (interval -0.082 to +0.020) for production's Adam. The first design row (planner_search_design_arms_481800) limited every number to 2 trust units by clamping each candidate, which breaks the step's proportionality wherever a number reaches the limit, and could not show steps of that size; it was stopped before its first decision. The search now scales the whole step along the ray to the region's boundary (lem/model/planner_search.py, commit of this row's job). This row reads the limits on the body's outcome on raw encoder tokens (the mechanism reading had only the tokens as fed, which hold up to half of the model's own prediction) and sets the two strongest searches of the mechanism reading beside the trust search on the same decisions.
rows.gof_link: The planner helps gain of function only when its command ends nearer the goal in the real body in proprioception and vision; this reading sets the search's constants on that outcome and on nothing predicted.
inputs: Production checkpoint ckpt_step_481800 of run H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg41o_1431 (read only) and its saved eight-world episode; per body its first 8 saved planning decisions, 10 model steps or more apart, reached under the model's own behaviour.

Reference arms: reflex (the motor controller's command), start_hand (the motor controller's command followed by the hand stage that follows every search: the reference every search arm is read against), chosen (production's Adam search as it ran in the session).

Comparison arms from the mechanism reading: sgd (production's search with Adam replaced by updates proportional to the gradient in the command's own units, the largest number moving 0.1 of its unit at the first update, 20 updates) and adam_lr0.01 (Adam at learning rate 0.01).

Trust arms (docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/design_arms_v2.json), each the whole step with no selection: x_b2_f25, x_b2_f50, x_b2 (split regions, 8 smoothing rows, no number past 2 trust units: a quarter, a half and the whole of the step); x_b4 (no number past 4); x_r8_f25, x_r8_f50, x_r8 (a length of at most 8 trust units and no number past 2); b_b2 (one region, no number past 2); x0_b2 and x16_b2 (0 and 16 smoothing rows); best16 (the command of lowest predicted objective among the motor controller's and 16 commands drawn around it at the babble's sizes, no gradient step), for the record only.

The code of branch planner/search-2026-10-05 at the commit the job is pinned to: lem/model/planner_search.py, lem/model/intention_generator.py (SearchObjective), mimo_bridge/lem_model.py (_plan_chain, _search_layout), docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/arms_probe.py (version planner_search_arms_v4), trust_arm.py, design_arms_v2.json, design_choice.py.
steps: Two worker processes of 4 threads each (bodies 0 to 3 and 4 to 7), run from an export of the pinned commit (docs/gain_of_function_v4/pinned_job.py). Per body, restore its saved world and model state with learning off, run under the model's own behaviour to a planning decision, take a snapshot, write the decision file.
Per decision and arm, run LemLite._plan_chain from the decision's captured state with the arm's search (hand stage as production runs it); the snapshot is restored before every search.

Route checks that stop the job: the probe's predicted goal distance of chosen and reflex must equal the planning record's to 0.001; the physical traces of two executions of reflex and of chosen must be bit-identical; the weights are hashed before and after.

Execute every arm's command from the identical restored snapshot for the 5-model-step hold. After the first and the fifth model step read each sense's raw encoder token and its top-down-gated token; goal distance per sense = the mean over the token's 192 numbers of (token - the goal's token) squared.

Summarise per arm, arm minus start_hand and arm minus reflex: predicted 1 model step ahead, real after 1 model step and real after the hold, for proprioception plus vision, each sense and the plain sum, on the raw tokens and on the gated tokens, as the mean over the 8 body means with a 95% interval from resampling whole bodies.

Compose the flag's forms from the executed arms (design_choice.py): per decision the command of lowest PREDICTED objective among start_hand and the form's three candidates (F_B2: x_b2_f25, x_b2_f50, x_b2; F_B4: x_b2_f50, x_b2, x_b4; F_R8: x_r8_f25, x_r8_f50, x_r8); its real outcome is that command's. Apply the rule below and write design_choice.json.
measures: P: real goal distance in proprioception plus vision after the hold on the raw encoder tokens, arm minus start_hand from the same saved state, squared token units: below 0 = the arm's command ended nearer the goal; start_hand's own level is the scale.
P1: the same after 1 model step (the horizon the search predicts); the plain sum and tactile beside both, as the check that nothing got worse; the same against reflex (the purpose's comparison).

Per trust arm: the share of the squared step that went to the strengths, the step per group in physical units, the share of the region used, the predicted objective and goal distance at the start and at the step.

Per arm the command's difference from the motor controller's as the body receives it (degrees on the average body handle, cm, strength), the handles' real displacement over the hold, and the search's seconds.
rows.target_metric: P of the composed search: below 0 = the search's command ended nearer its goal than the motor controller's command with the same hand stage, in the senses a command can change; 0 = no nearer.
rows.baseline: start_hand (0 by construction); chosen (production's Adam search from the same saved state); reflex for the purpose's comparison.
rows.statistical_line: A reading is told from noise when its 95% interval from resampling the 8 bodies lies entirely on one side of 0; two arms are told apart when the mean of their per-decision difference is larger than its standard error over the 64 decisions.
rows.pass_line: No pass or fail line on the outcome: a design reading whose rule fixes the flag's settings. RULE, applied in this sequence to P. (1) Shape: one region (b_b2) replaces split regions (x_b2) only when its P is lower by more than the standard error of the paired difference. (2) Limits: F_B4 replaces F_B2 when its P is lower by more than the standard error of the paired difference; then F_R8 replaces the form kept when its P is lower than that form's by more than the standard error of the paired difference. (3) Smoothing rows: 16 when x16_b2's P is below x_b2's by more than the standard error of the paired difference; 0 when x0_b2's is; else 8. (4) chosen, sgd, adam_lr0.01 and best16 select nothing; each is set beside the chosen form with the same paired statistics, and when sgd or adam_lr0.01 is lower than the chosen form by more than the standard error the record states it with what the stability requirement costs that search. The job is complete when all 64 decisions are measured with every route check held.
rows.pass_line_basis: Defaults when the body's outcome cannot tell two settings apart: split regions, because in one region the effort term's gradient on the 26 strengths took 0.69 of the squared step at the development decision (the predicted gain consisting of a strength cut is what the repair exists to remove); no number past 2 trust units, because 2 is the babble's own range for one number in 95 of 100 draws (N(0, 1) trust unit per number), so the step stays among commands the forward model was trained on; 8 smoothing rows, whose mean direction agreed between two independent sets with a cosine of 0.995 at the development decision. Reachability: a paired difference between two arms from one saved state has no between-state noise; in the mechanism reading the per-decision standard errors of arm differences after the hold were 0.01 to 0.03 for proprioception plus vision (tokens as fed), so differences of that size are what 64 decisions resolve. Every constant fixed here is read once more on checkpoint 480,829 (row planner_search_evidence_physical_480829), which plays no part in the rule.

rows.title: Planner switch watch: the cost of one check
rows.question: What does one check of the planner switch watch cost, in seconds, memory and lines parsed, on production's held run and the run folders its lineage walk reaches: version 2 of this branch against version 1 as the independent review read it?
rows.why: The independent review's finding M3: version 1 parsed the whole stats file of the run and of up to 16 parent runs at every 5-minute check and kept every parsed record, beside training, and its cost was never measured. Version 2 searches each file's text for the words planner_switch, parses no report while no switch is found, and reads each file from where the last check ended. The decision that depends on this row: whether the watch's hook goes into production's hourly watcher as built (it runs at every 5-minute check beside training).
rows.gof_link: Trustworthy measurement and control: a stop-rule program that takes processor time and memory from the trainer at every check changes the training it guards.
inputs: Production's held run H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg41o_1431 and the parent run folders its continuation receipts name, up to the watch's walk limit of 16 folders (89.5 MB of stats files on Oct 5), read only.

rows.title: PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR evidence on saved decisions: repeatability on two devices, stability under 0.00001 and 0.0001 input noise, the candidates and the score (16 decisions of 481,800)
rows.question: On 16 saved planning decisions of checkpoint 481,800 (the first 2 of each body), searched by the launch flag's frozen second design (--planner-search trust_v2; the first design trust_v1 failed gate clause (b)) on the graphics card and on the processor: is the selected command equal to the bit when one decision is searched twice in one process; how far apart are the two devices' commands (the float32 floor); how much does the selected command change under Gaussian noise of 0.00001 and 0.0001 on the present tokens, on the goal's tokens and on the starting command, against production's Adam under 0.00001 token noise on the same decisions; does any searched number's step change sign beyond the float32 floor; is the selected candidate the one of lowest predicted objective and never above the start; do the record's parts sum to its total and equal a recomputation from the recorded tokens; and how many seconds does a decision take on each device against Adam?
rows.why: Requirements R2 (the selected command is a smooth function of the search's inputs), R5 (never predicted above the start; deterministic), R6 (passes and time per decision on both devices) and R7 (the record) of the repair are claims about the search's arithmetic. They are read here on saved decisions whose inputs are known exactly, before the whole loop and the body's outcome. The stability line is declared here from the float32 floor this row measures (the same decisions on two devices), as the coordinator's brief asks.
rows.gof_link: A planner command can serve gain of function only when it is a repeatable function of the state and the goal; a command that a 0.00001 change of the input turns by 22 degrees on the average body handle (production's Adam, rows planner_search_mechanism_offline and the review of Oct 4) cannot be learned from or relied on.
inputs: The decision files of row planner_search_mechanism_arms (checkpoint 481,800): the first 2 decisions of each of the 8 bodies, 16 in all. Each holds the present tokens of the five real senses (192 numbers each), the goal's tokens, the motor controller's command (26 body handles x 9 numbers), the context, the achieved pose, the hand goal and the route digest of the model that captured it.
Checkpoint ckpt_step_481800 of run H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg41o_1431, read only.
Noise: Gaussian, standard deviation 0.00001 and 0.0001 per number, 2 seeded draws each, on (a) the five senses' present tokens, (b) the goal's tokens, (c) the starting command's 26 x 9 numbers.

the code of branch planner/search-2026-10-05 at the commit the job is pinned to (docs/gain_of_function_v4/pinned_job.py exports it; a later edit of the worktree cannot reach the job), with lem/model/planner_search.py's SETTINGS_V2 as frozen by the declared rules of rows planner_search_design_arms_481800_v4 to _v6 (commit 7cbbee6d6: the one-step form v2a) and UNITS (declaration.json records the method and its settings); docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/evidence_offline.py (version planner_search_evidence_offline_v1). The search under test is selected with --settings '{"method": "trust_v2"}' (no other setting: the flag's frozen SETTINGS_V2).
steps: Graphics card run (under D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/gpu.lock): evidence_offline.py --device cuda:0 --per-body 2 --settings '{"method": "trust_v2"}' into D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/planner_search/evidence_offline_481800_gpu_v2. Build the model through the trainer's builder with learning off (weights hashed before and after); stop when the model differs from the digest the decision files carry.

Per decision: LemLite._plan_chain with the flag's search twice (repeat); once with the hand goal left out (the search's own output, every body's hand joints searched); then under each noise size and target and draw, with and without the hand stage; production's Adam on the decision and under 2 draws of 0.00001 token noise, with and without the hand stage; the record's candidates; the record's parts and the selected command predicted again on the probes' own route (LemLite.planned_execution and the transition through probe_planner_candidates).
Processor run: the same into evidence_offline_481800_cpu_v2 with --device cpu and the same --settings.

Verdict: evidence_offline.py --verdict <gpu folder> <cpu folder> --out verdict.json computes the float32 floor (the search alone, per decision, graphics card against processor) and the lines below on both runs.
measures: Change of the selected command: degrees between the asked orientations of one body handle (0 = the same; two unrelated orientations average 126), mean over the 15 body handles that are not fingers and the largest; cm between asked positions on the rows whose position the decoder solves for; degrees of the eyes' row; strength (0 to 1); radians of the hand joints.

The selected step z in trust units (5 cm, 28.6 degrees, 3.23 degrees of the eyes, 0.05 strength, 0.192 rad): its largest change and the numbers whose step changed sign, with the size of the largest such step.
Candidates: the predicted objective at the start and at each fraction of the step; whether the selected one is the lowest and not above the start.

Score: |goal + effort + action space + wellness - objective|; |sum of the senses' distances - goal|; the selected command's per-sense goal distance predicted again against the record's; the effort term recomputed from the selected strengths.
Seconds of LemLite._plan_chain for one body, trust_v1 and Adam, on each device.
rows.target_metric: The change of the selected command under 0.00001 input noise, degrees on the average body handle: 0 = the same command; production's Adam read 22.3 on 479,350.
rows.baseline: Production's Adam on the same decisions under the same 0.00001 token noise, measured in this job.
rows.statistical_line: Every line except two is read on every decision (no mean hides one decision): the size line is a mean over the 16 decisions and 2 draws because its Adam reference is such a mean, and the grows line is a median over the decisions whose change is above the floor.
rows.pass_line: All of: (1) repeat: on the processor the two searches of one decision in one process are equal to the bit at 16 of 16; on the graphics card they differ by at most the float32 floor of (2) (the largest difference of one searched number of z between the devices); (2) two processes: the largest difference of one searched number of the step z between the graphics card and the processor is at most 0.001 trust unit; (3) size: under 0.00001 noise on the tokens, on the goal and on the starting command, the mean change of the selected command (search alone) is at most the larger of 1/100 of Adam's under 0.00001 token noise on the same decisions and 100 times the float32 floor of the same quantity, for the turn of the average body handle and for the position; (4) grows: over the decisions whose change under 0.00001 token noise is above 10 times the float32 floor (largest turn of a handle), the median of the change under 0.0001 divided by the change under 0.00001 is at least 3; (5) signs: under 0.00001 noise on any of the three, every searched number whose step changes sign has a step of at most 1/100 of the step's largest number; (6) candidates: the selected candidate is the lowest predicted and not above the start at 16 of 16; (7) score: parts minus objective at most 0.00001, senses minus goal at most 0.00001, a sense's distance predicted again within 0.001 of the record's, the effort term within 0.000001.
rows.pass_line_basis: (2) 0.001 trust unit is a thousandth of the spread of one number in the commands the forward model was trained on (the babble draws each number from N(0, 1) trust unit). (3) 1/100 of Adam's: the coordinator's expectation of a change smaller than Adam's by two powers of ten or more; 100 times the float32 floor: a change within two powers of ten of the difference two devices' arithmetic makes cannot be told from that arithmetic. (4) A response proportional to the input gives a ratio of 10 for a tenfold input; a change that comes from a switch of what the attention reads gives a ratio near 1 at both sizes; 3 lies between. (5) A response that follows the input flips only numbers whose step is near 0 (the 8-row mean direction changed by at most 0.0034 of its length under 0.00001 noise, row planner_search_design_offline_481800); an update of Adam's kind moves every number by a full update whatever its gradient, a share near 1; 1/100 lies between. The line was first written as 10 times the float32 floor of the step and set to this share at 6:18 AM PDT, before the row ran: a response proportional to a 0.00001 input change flips numbers whose step is up to 0.0034 x 2 trust units, above 10 times a float32 floor. (7) The parts are summed by the same code (only float32 rounding is allowed); the recomputation runs a separately assembled route whose route checks elsewhere hold to 0.001. Reachability: on the development decision the trust search's command changed by 0.0002 degrees and 0.00001 cm under 0.00001 token noise, against 36.7 degrees for Adam on the same decision. (1) on the graphics card: the stability reading of the second design's forms (row planner_search_design_stability_v2_481800, read at 8:01 AM PDT) found the same search repeated in one process on the card equal to the bit at 2 of 8 and 3 of 8 decisions: the card's sums in the backward pass need not run in the same sequence twice. The repeat line on the card was set to the float32 floor before the second design's evidence ran.

rows.title: PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR in the whole loop: 32 planning decisions inside LemLite.step on the graphics card with checkpoint 481,800, the hand stage and the causal chain record
rows.question: When the model is built by the trainer's own builder with --planner-search trust_v1 and lives under its own behaviour from H84's saved worlds on the graphics card, does every planning decision inside LemLite.step run the trust search, write its record into the planning record as plain JSON, hand the body the planned command through the decision's transform, run the hand stage after it, stay out of mixed precision, and replay to the bit from the captured decision; and how many seconds does a decision take against Adam, for one body and for 8 bodies in one batch?
rows.why: The offline evidence reads the search alone; the contract's second question asks which test ran the whole loop the change lives in (a planning decision inside the model's own step, with the hand stage and the decision record), on which device and for how many decisions. rows.title: PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR gate clause (b): the repaired search's command against production's Adam from the same saved state, in the simulated body (8 decisions x 8 bodies on each of checkpoints 480,829 and 479,350)
rows.question: On checkpoints that played no part in choosing the search's constants (480,829 of run seg41o_1431 and 479,350 of run seg41m_0402; 8 bodies x 8 planning decisions each, 128 decisions, 16 body clusters), executed for the 5-model-step hold from the same saved world state: does the repaired search's command end nearer its goal in proprioception plus vision on raw encoder tokens than production's Adam's command, with the 95% interval of the mean difference from resampling body clusters entirely below 0?
rows.why: The coordinator's gate QUALIFIED/OFF (Oct 5, 6:2x AM PDT, the operator's priority) asks for paired same-state trials in which the repaired search's command ends nearer the goal than today's search's command, with the interval clear of run-to-run scatter. The design readings on 481,800 chose the constants; this trial reads them on two other checkpoints.
rows.gof_link: The planner helps gain of function only when the command it sends instead of today's ends nearer the goal in the senses a command can change; this is the comparison the switch would make in production.
inputs: Checkpoints ckpt_step_480829 (run H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg41o_1431) and ckpt_step_479350 (run H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg41m_0402) with their saved eight-world episodes, read only; per body the first 8 planning decisions, 10 model steps or more apart.

Arms (docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/gate_arms.json written before the run): reflex (the motor controller's command), start_hand (with the hand stage), chosen (production's Adam), trust (the flag's search as frozen at the pinned commit), the per-group forms tg2 and tg4 (regions groups, no number past 2 and 4 trust units, the flag's selection among the start and 0.25, 0.5 and 1 of the step), and sgd (gradient descent in the command's own units, for the record).

THE ARM READ FOR THE GATE is fixed before the run by the design rules on 481,800: trust (split regions, limit 2) unless the third design reading's rule (row planner_search_design_arms_481800_v3) chooses the per-group form, then tg2 or tg4 as that rule says; the other arms are read for the record only, after the gate's reading.
docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/arms_probe.py, design_jobs.py, gate_trial.py at the pinned commit.
steps: Per checkpoint one job of two worker processes of 4 threads (bodies 0 to 3 and 4 to 7), run from an export of the pinned commit: restore each body's saved world and model state with learning off, run to each planning decision, run every arm's search from the captured state and execute every arm's command from the identical restored snapshot for the hold; read raw tokens after 1 and 5 model steps. Route checks as row planner_search_design_arms_481800_v2.

gate_trial.py: per decision d = P(arm read) - P(chosen); the mean over the 16 body clusters' means with its 95% interval from resampling clusters (10,000 draws, seed 20261005); the same against reflex and start_hand and per sense.
measures: d: the difference of the real goal distance in proprioception plus vision after the hold on raw tokens (mean over each token's 192 numbers of (token - goal token) squared), the arm read minus production's Adam, from the same saved state: below 0 = the repaired search's command ended nearer the goal; the motor controller's command's own distance (0.40 on 481,800) is the scale.
The same against the motor controller's command and start_hand; proprioception, vision, tactile and the plain sum of the five real senses beside it.
rows.target_metric: d, the arm read minus production's Adam: below 0 = nearer the goal than today's search's command; 0 = no nearer.
rows.baseline: Production's Adam (chosen) from the same saved state.
rows.statistical_line: The 95% interval of the mean over the 16 body clusters' means, from resampling clusters, lies entirely below 0.
rows.pass_line: Gate clause (b) is met when the 95% interval of d for the arm read lies entirely below 0; else it is not met. Reported beside it, deciding nothing: d against the motor controller's command and start_hand, and per sense.
rows.pass_line_basis: REACHABILITY, from the second design reading's 64 decisions on 481,800 (docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/reachability.py): the per-decision difference against Adam has a spread of 0.11 to 0.14 inside a body and 0.01 to 0.05 between bodies, because Adam's own outcome swings with its large commands. With 16 clusters of 8 decisions the interval's half-width is about 2.1 x sqrt(s_between^2 / 16 + s_within^2 / 128): 0.022 for the spreads gradient descent in the command's own units showed (mean difference -0.030: the line would be met), 0.027 for the trust form split-2's (mean -0.005: the line would not be met at any trial size with 8 bodies per checkpoint). So the line is reachable only for an arm whose mean advantage over Adam is near 0.03; the trial is run at the largest size the saved episodes give per checkpoint (8 decisions per body) on the two checkpoints not used for the choice.

rows.on_fail: Gate clause (b) is written as not met with the interval and the reachability arithmetic; PLANNER_SEARCH_REPAIR stays BUILT/OFF and the coordinator is told, with what the readings show a search would need (its mean advantage over Adam near 0.03 at this scatter).

rows.title: Which losses train the wellness predictor's layers
rows.question: On checkpoint 481,800, in one live model step and one replay update of the trainer's own code on the processor, which loss terms give a gradient above 0 to each layer of the wellness predictor (wellness.approximate.net.0, net.2, net.4) and to the liveness repair's rows that compute the revived units of net.0 and net.2, and do those rows change between checkpoints 480,829 and 481,800 while net.2's own weights stay at 0?
rows.why: The Oct 4 audit read a gradient of exactly 0 on net.2's weight and bias in a live model step. If the liveness repair's rows compute all of net.2's units and take the wellness lesson's gradient, that 0 is the expected sign of the takeover and no gradient repair is needed; if no tensor that computes net.2 gets the lesson's gradient, net.2 cannot learn and that tensor is the repair's target. PLANNER_PROSPECTIVE_TERM scores candidate commands with this predictor.
rows.gof_link: Wellness can change command choice through the planner only if the wellness predictor that scores predicted outcomes is trained; this reads whether any lesson reaches its middle layer.

inputs: Production checkpoint ckpt_step_481800 of run H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg41o_1431 (read only) and its saved eight-world episode; per body the first 2 planning decisions.

docs/gain_of_function_v4/planner_recovery/arms_probe.py, design_jobs.py, outcome_spread.py at the pinned commit.
steps: Two jobs (bodies 0 to 3 and 4 to 7), each of two worker processes of 4 threads, from an export of the pinned commit: per body restore its saved world and model state with learning off, run to each of its first 2 planning decisions, run every arm's search from the captured state and execute every arm's command from the identical restored snapshot for the hold; raw tokens after the hold.

measures: Q per form: sqrt(mean over the decisions of (P(X) - P(X_n1))^2 / 2), the root mean square of the two draws' standard deviation of P, in P's own units (0 = the same outcome; the motor controller's command's own P is about 0.40 on 481,800 and the decision-to-decision spread of a form's gain over Adam about 0.10); the mean and the largest |P(X) - P(X_n1)|.

rows.pass_line: THE LINE (the operator's decision of Oct 5, after 9:08 AM PDT, option (b); its value is written into this row from row planner_search_design_arms_481800_v6's reading BEFORE any outcome spread of this job is read, and is then frozen): L = G / 10, where G is the smallest gain over production's Adam that the held-out trial (480,829 and 479,350: 16 body clusters, 32 decisions per body, the largest size the joint gate row declares) shows in 80 of 100 runs at the frozen second design v2a's own spreads of d on its development reading (row v6; smallest_gain.py: (t(15, 0.975) + t(15, 0.80)) x sqrt(s_between^2 / 16 + s_within^2 / (16 x 32))). BASIS: a result of the trial must not come from input rounding, so the outcome change that a rounding-sized input change (Gaussian noise of 0.00001 per token number) causes must be small against the smallest gain the trial can show; one tenth puts the rounding part of one decision's outcome at a tenth of that gain or less, and its part of the trial's mean lower still by the square root of the decisions averaged. The line is not taken from gradient descent's numbers (no reading of gradient descent enters G or the factor) and was set before any search's outcome spread was read under it; Adam's outcome spread (a standard deviation of 0.033 between three noise draws on 32 decisions of 481,800, gated tokens, row planner_search_mechanism_arms) is the only outcome spread read before it. VALUE (written at Oct 5, 2026 10:20 AM PDT from row planner_search_design_arms_481800_v6, read at 10:20 AM, before any outcome spread of this job was read; FROZEN): v2a's spreads of d on its 64 development decisions: s_within 0.1097, s_between 0.0484 (D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/planner_search/smallest_gain_v6.json); G = 2.997 x sqrt(0.0484^2 / 16 + 0.1097^2 / 512) = 0.0391; L = 0.00391 in P's units (the motor controller's command's own P about 0.40). RULE for the design under the line (written before any reading of this job): (1) admissible = the form's Q on this job's decisions at most L; (2) best = among the admissible forms the largest gain over v2a, each form's paired gain over v2a read in its own development job (p5 and p10 in row planner_search_design_arms_481800_v6, s4 and s8 in row planner_search_design_arms_481800_v7; v2a's own is 0), a form earlier in the sequence v2a, s4, s8, p5, p10 (the smaller search first) replacing it when the difference of the two paired gains is within one standard error (the two jobs' standard errors combined as the root of the sum of squares); (3) the best form is frozen as trust_v2 on one commit; the held-out trial on 480,829 and 479,350 runs only when the best form's gain over Adam in its own development job is at least the smallest gain the trial shows in 80 of 100 runs at that form's own spreads for some n of 8, 16, 24 or 32 decisions per body (the smallest such n), the coordinator's rule of 9:06 AM; else no held-out decision is spent and the coordinator is told.
rows.pass_line_basis: The operator's decision (option (b)) and the coordinator's rule of 9:06 AM: a held-out trial runs only for a frozen design whose development reading predicts at least the gain the trial can show. The stability line of the joint gate row becomes Q on the held-out decisions at most L (that row is restated before its trial).

2: test_ht_break.py. Test 1, the method's control: inside one autocast block a Linear's first use without gradient leaves a later use without gradient.
